claim_limits: This audit proves completion only for original I04-I08 scope, including executed negative, diagnostic and explicitly conditional-gated findings. It never proves all13 complete.
All cases are supplied synthetic tasks. Model proposals, model grades and deterministic arithmetic do not establish that any physical, workflow, enabling or human probe was performed.
The original I06 pilot remains temporally invalid; branch admission and proper heldout raw-first comparisons cannot retroactively repair it or confer replication/advantage credit.
Five proper-phase post reviews remain invalid. Eleven retention rows are gated null, not zero, lost or successful. Raw comparison validity is separate from post retention validity.
Qualification and family relations remain case-local with null scalar/family judgments preserved; no transitive forced family merge, statistical significance or broad generalization follows.
I05 confirmation has one qualified parent-B card and zero qualified intact-interface cards. No measured interface synergy or physical coupling follows from production differences.
I04/I07/I08 have zero qualified pilot distinction and all heldouts administratively gated; no result or call is invented for unrun phases.

I08 shared concerns receive zero convergence creation credit. Identical source reports, preserved contradiction judgments and agreement do not establish truth, whole Robot Talks effectiveness or two-lane effects.

Archive provenance supports local novelty comparison only; its limited ordinary-family archive cannot establish global originality. Cross-study shared cases/controls do not add independent replication.

Native read-boundary compliance is evidenced by assigned prompt, fresh-context and bound native witnesses, not by direct observation of internal reasoning. The permitted closure is the evidence ceiling.

Original I06 diagnostic lock paths are named in the assigned summary but not in the explicit source union; they were not read. Exact assigned diagnostic packets, dual reviews, original native first saves, timing receipts and null-preserving deterministic comparison provide the audited diagnostic coverage.

Preparation and completion-audit overhead are separate from 223 scored study calls. Saved words are burden proxies; actual tokens and internal model calls remain unknown. No unused role allowance is transferred.
I10/I13 pool dependencies are retained as context; no downstream study completion, real human decision value, deployment readiness or whole-workflow benefit is certified here.
